title: PIXL 8000 Strawberry Kiwi Razz Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Strawberry Kiwi Razz blends sweet Strawberry, tangy Kiwi and juicy Blue Raspberry for a fruity trio full of energy and contrast. It’s a vibrant, well-rounded vape with a hint of tartness to balance the sweetness. Each pod contains 2ml of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and is paired with a 10ml refill reservoir for up to 8000 puffs when used with the PIXL 8000 Prefilled Pod Vape Kit. Mesh coil technology supports smooth vapour and lasting flavour. MTL-friendly and simple to use with draw activation and optional Boost Mode, Strawberry Kiwi Razz is one of the most dynamic blends in the PIXL range.
